verdict: no blockers; 2 major (pick-and-place kinematics/visibility), 4 minor. Physics-facing visuals pass: no mid-air weights, stack shrinks 1 per transfer, single-sided buckle (no reversal), no edgewise bending, no flicker, camera locked.

findings.title: Pick-and-place quill moves implausibly fast: strobes/pops in and out within 1-3 frames
findings.detail: build_anim.py phases (gap g=0.6 s): close->lift (to z_travel 0.52 m) spans ts-0.306..ts-0.258 s = 48 ms, i.e. ~0.45-0.49 m vertical at ~10 m/s mean (smoothstep peak ~15 m/s, accel tens of g) while holding a 20 g disc. Measured in preview: gripper jumps from the stack (y~480 px) to the frame top in ONE frame (f12->f13, ~450 px = ~360 mm). Quill is visible only ~6 frames per cycle; render.use_motion_blur=False, so it reads as popping/teleporting, which the contract's 'visible path, lowered gently, no teleporting' intends to exclude.
findings.suggested_fix: spread hover/grip/lift over >=0.25 s of each 0.6 s cycle (peak speed <=1 m/s), lower z_travel to just above the peg-top clearance, and/or enable motion blur for the final render.

findings.title: Weight transit is off-screen for ~8 frames per transfer (path not visible)
findings.detail: After the lift the disc exits the top of the frame at the stack x (f13-14) and re-enters above the peg at f22 (same pattern each transfer, e.g. seat 4: in gripper f65-66, seated f67-68, gripper leaves f69). Horizontal transit happens at z_travel=0.52 m, above the frame top. Partly geometric: the peg top sits ~8 px below the frame edge, so a disc clearing the 40 mm peg must touch the edge; but the transit could run at a lower height in-frame up to the peg and only rise over it.
findings.suggested_fix: travel at the lowest height that clears the strip/peg (just above the peg tip), approaching the peg in-frame; keep the final lowering (currently ~3 frames, ~0.3 m/s near the seat) at least as slow.

findings.title: Look is more saturated/contrasty than the reference; bench slightly lighter/yellower
findings.detail: Frame 0 full-frame MAD (8-bit): ours vs ref 10.3, ours vs frame0.png 3.28, ref vs frame0.png 9.69, so we match the frame given to the generator; the gap is the generator's softer, hazier grade. Region mean Lab diff (8-bit units) ours-ref: bench_left L+8.2 b+3.7, bench_right L+5.3 b+3.4, pegboard L+1.6..3.1 b+3.2, vise L+2.1, strip L+0.8. Materials read correctly (satin brushed steel, brass slotted weights, teal cast vise, perforated pegboard, wood bench). Expected difference vs reference: 40 mm peg (ref 20 mm) and the quill (disclosed).
findings.suggested_fix: optional: a slight contrast/saturation reduction (or a mild bloom/haze) in the final grade if closer reference match is wanted.

findings.title: Intersection check samples only even integer frames; fast gripper contacts fall on odd frames
findings.detail: Gripper-stack/gripper-peg proximity lasts only 2-4 frames per pick, so half of them are unchecked (gripping pairs are also exempt). No interpenetration is visible in the 50% preview (the gripper bar sits in front of the stack in f10/11/31/45/74/88/102, not resolvable at this resolution).
findings.suggested_fix: check every frame plus subframes during the pick/seat windows.

findings.title: Checkpoint checks.json references the mutable working-dir npz, not the checkpoint copy
findings.detail: Both files are byte-identical today (sha256 b4d33b67...93b45, also listed in MANIFEST), but provenance should point inside the immutable checkpoint.

findings.title: No motion blur on fast strip swings
findings.detail: render.use_motion_blur=False; the topple f144-f162 moves the tip ~30-40 px/frame at 50% scale, so it looks slightly steppy at 24 fps. The reference has natural blur.
findings.suggested_fix: enable Cycles motion blur (shutter ~0.5) for the final render; the pc2 cache has subframes.

findings.title: Bench stack shrinks by exactly one per transfer
findings.detail: Stack top y at quiet frames 424,429,432,436,441,445,450,453 px: 7 decrements of 3-5 px (mean 4.1 px), then constant to f240. The top disc is the one lifted (visible in gripper at f12, f60).

findings.title: No AI defects imitated
findings.detail: Weights never appear mid-air without the gripper; the peg count grows 1 at a time (1..7); the buckle stays toward -Y (camera-left) with a damped sway: tip-body tilt 5.2 deg f126, 59.9 f156, max 75.4 deg at f164.2, 18.0 f192, 68.2 f228, 63.1 f240 (never >90, so the weights stay on the peg); weak-axis bending only (no edgewise lean). Disc faces near-white at the deep swing (max luma 241, 0 clipped px), consistent with the reference's brass faces.

findings.title: Temporal stability: no flicker, camera locked
findings.detail: Static regions, median per-pixel temporal std 0.0-0.43 (8-bit) vs reference 0.82-1.25; max consecutive-frame region MAD 0.45 (bench_right, quill shadow); max pegboard phase-correlation shift 0.51 px (scene check: camera 0.0006 px).
